text:
olivia.marketing: Quick heads-up — want to try a lightweight prefetch step for HubSpot enrichment to smooth handoff SLA spikes. thinking 1% canary first.

jordan-sdr: Sounds good. what does prefetch do exactly here?

olivia.marketing: Prefetch will request enrichment records (email + company match) as soon as lead is created, before round-robin assign. should reduce latency when SDRs claim.

leo-growth: Will this affect webhook throughput? we already see batching on the connector.

olivia.marketing: Good point. plan is non-blocking prefetch: try enrichment but always return a fallback within 150ms. only persist extra data if it arrives < 3s.

sara-salesops: Can we add a heartbeat/jitter guard so we don't double-assign during enrichment delays? last week there were 3 quick claims.

olivia.marketing: Yes — propose a 30s "prefetch grace" where claim logic prefers enriched leads, and claim lock stays for 45s. If enrichment still not ready after 45s, fall back to normal RR.

hs-sync-bot: Deployment note: will need mapping change on HS->SF payloads (add `prefetch_status` + `enrich_age_ms`).

mike-ops: Quick config snippet i put together for canary: 
```json
{"canary_pct":1, "prefetch_timeout_ms":3000, "fallback_timeout_ms":150, "claim_lock_ms":45000, "heartbeat_ms":30000}
```

jordan-sdr: for the canary — which leads? all inbound or only high-intent (MQL) first?

olivia.marketing: Start with MQL (utm + demo intent). If stable after 48h, expand to 10% all inbound.

sara-salesops: Add one metric: percent of claimed leads where enrichment arrived before claim. want to see improvement vs baseline.

mike-ops: I'll add a dashboard tile: `enrich_before_claim_rate` + `avg_claim_latency_ms`. also instrument retry count.

leo-growth: Any messaging changes for SDRs? could be confusing if fields appear shortly after claim.

olivia.marketing: We'll add a small banner in HS notes: "Enrichment may arrive post-claim — check 'company score' field" and a tooltip. short comms in #sales this afternoon.

hs-sync-bot: FYI: rolling config flag created `prefetch_enrich_v1` for canary rollout.

jordan-sdr: 👍 if ops can push the dashboard and we get a simple README i can brief the team.

olivia.marketing: Plan: ops + salesops push canary today at 5pm PT, monitor 48h, quick sync Fri 11am PT. Thanks all :rocket:
